content.text:
“Best value” depends on the child’s age, preferred curriculum and where you live. On the available **2026–27** fee information, these are good places to start:

| School | Why it may be good value | Published fee indication |
|---|---|---|
| **Hanoi International School (HIS)** | A relatively affordable **full IB** option, with the PYP, MYP and Diploma Programme. | About **₫418 million** for kindergarten, **₫590–600 million** for early primary and **₫767 million** for Grades 11–12. First-year charges can include a ₫26 million enrolment fee and ₫5 million test fee; the ₫50 million deposit is refundable. |
| **BVIS Hanoi** | Worth comparing if you want a British-style pathway with an international environment and want to keep costs below the top tier. | A secondary source reports **₫480.4 million for Year 1**, including lunch, trips and health insurance. Confirm the exact grade-by-grade schedule and what is included directly with the school. |
| **Hanoi International School’s upper grades / other mid-priced options** | HIS’s published figures make it a useful benchmark for families seeking an established international programme without UNIS-level fees. | Compare total annual costs, not just tuition—transport, meals, application charges and deposits can change the picture. |
| **UNIS Hanoi** | Not a budget choice, but may represent strong value if its established IB programme and international community are priorities. | 2026–27 tuition is **US$33,330–39,870** for Grades 1–12; fees are much lower in Early Years. |

**My short take:** For value among established international schools, **HIS is the clearest starting point**, especially if you want the IB continuum. **BVIS** may suit families looking for a British pathway and inclusive fee packages. **UNIS** is a premium option, so its value depends more on fit than price.

Before deciding, request a written, grade-specific quote from each school and compare **first-year total cost** (including one-time fees), what tuition includes, class size, curriculum and accreditation, language support, transport time, and likely fee increases. Published fee data can be incomplete or change, so verify current figures with the schools.
